$comment: The single source of truth for FocusBro's ambient audio. scripts/audio/build.py renders every sound from this file into audio/dist/ (not committed — the files live in R2), and regenerates audio/manifest.json, audio/SOURCES.md and the manifest block in public/index.html. Field recordings are re-downloaded from their archive URLs; ElevenLabs takes are kept in R2 under sources/ because they cannot be regenerated byte-for-byte.
